Name: Warehouse Storage for FSF
Author: Eimakore
Description:
Warehouse Storage is a content pack for [b]Flexible Storage Framework[/b] that adds warehouse-themed storage containers designed for practical bulk storage and organization.

[b][size=4]The pack is fully functional on its own[/size][/b]. Pack & Preserve is not required, but optional integration is included to connect compatible storage containers with its progression and item system.

More storage types are planned and will be added in future updates.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Warehouse-themed storage containers[/*]
[*]Custom capacities and inventory layouts[/*]
[*]Progressive visuals based on stored items[/*]
[*]Color customization where supported[/*]
[*]Carry support through Flexible Storage Framework[/*]
[*]Custom storage sounds[/*]
[*]Optional item filters[/*]
[*]Configurable recipes and unlock levels through FSF[/*]
[*]Optional Pack & Preserve integration[/*]
[*]Current Storage[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Crate Pallet[/b][/size]

A compact pallet designed for storing stacked goods.

[list]
[*]Capacity: 12 slots[/*]
[*]Layout: 4 × 3[/*]
[*]Footprint: 2 × 1 tiles[/*]
[*]Progressive appearance from empty to fully loaded[/*]
[*]Player-selectable color[/*]
[*]Can be carried while containing items[/*]
[*]Unlocks at Farming Level 3[/*]
[*]Crafted using 50 Wood[/*]
[/list][b]Progressive appearance from empty to fully loaded[/b]
[list]
[*]The pallet’s appearance changes based on the number of occupied inventory slots.[/*]
[*]Each visible crate on the pallet represents one occupied slot.[/*]
[*]An empty storage appears as an empty pallet.[/*]
[*]Three occupied slots display three crates.[/*]
[*]Nine occupied slots display nine crates.[/*]
[*]A completely filled 12-slot storage displays all twelve crates.[/*]
[*]Stack size does not affect the appearance — a slot containing one item and a slot containing 999 items each display one crate.[/*]
[*]The appearance updates automatically whenever items are added or removed.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Pack & Preserve Integration[/b][/size]

If Pack & Preserve 2.0.0 or newer is installed, the Crate Pallet is automatically integrated into its progression.

With the integration enabled:

[list]
[*]The recipe is unlocked through the Packing Station mail instead of the normal Farming Level 3 unlock.[/*]
[*]The Crate Pallet is configured to store Pack & Preserve crates.[/*]
[*]The item filter can still be disabled through the FSF configuration if you prefer unrestricted storage.[/*]
[/list]
Without Pack & Preserve installed, the Crate Pallet simply uses its normal standalone recipe and skill unlock.

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[size=4]Required[/size]

[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[*]Flexible Storage Framework 1.3.0 or newer[/*]
[/list]
[size=4]Optional[/size]

[list]
[*]Pack & Preserve 2.0.0 or newer[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

Warehouse Storage supports the optional configuration system provided by Flexible Storage Framework.

Through GMCM, compatible settings such as recipe ingredients, skill unlock level, and item filtering can be adjusted without editing the content pack manually.

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

Warehouse Storage uses Flexible Storage Framework for all storage functionality.

Removing the optional Pack & Preserve integration does not prevent the storage containers themselves from working.

[size=4][b]Future Updates[/b][/size]

This pack is intended to grow over time. New warehouse-style storage containers will be added in future versions rather than waiting for the entire planned collection to be completed before release.
